title: Nuclear Construction Is Growing, And China Drives Half Of It
hook: The supposedly dying industry has a massive power pipeline underway.
closing: Nuclear construction is growing, concentrated, and already shaping tomorrow's electricity supply.
question: Would you live near nuclear power?

segments.say: Builders started 10 reactors worldwide, showing nuclear construction is growing rather than disappearing.
China holds 50 percent of capacity under construction, concentrating the global buildout in one country.
The pipeline totals 78 gigawatts, turning that concentrated buildout into future electricity.
